  • Method Details

    • match

      MappingStore match(Tree src, Tree dst, MappingStore mappings)
      Compute and return the mappings between a provided src and dst AST. The mappings are added as a side effect in the provided mapping store. The provided mapping store is return as well to allow chaining.
